If you want people to see you as confident, you need these 3 body language tricks.
Most guys get the first one wrong without even knowing it.
First, take up space. Stop folding into yourself.
Shoulders back, chin slightly up, and stand still.
Walk slower, talk slower, even turn your head slower.
Rushing tells people you don't feel you belong there.
Hands visible, not in pockets, not crossed.
Your brain trusts open hands. So does everyone else's.
